Bench: A.J.Desai, Biren Vaishnav
 C/Sca/11006/2022 Order

DATED: 21/03/2023  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CIVIL APPLICATION NO. 11006 of 2022 ==========================================================
 PATEL MANEKLAL BECHARDAS  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR RAKESH R PATEL(3239) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 MS. SHRUNJAL SHAH, ASSISTANT GOVERNMENT PLEADER for the Respondent(s) No. 1,2,3 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR.
 JUSTICE A.J.DESAI  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIREN VAISHNAV  Date : 21/03/2023  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI) 1

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By way of present petition under Article 14, 300-A and 226 of the Constitution of India, following prayers have been made:
"18 (A) That this Honourable Court may be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus or a writ in the nature of Mandamus and/or any other appropriate writ or order ofr direction holding that the utilisation of the respective land of the petitioners by the respondent no.3 for the purpose of state highway without paying any compensation or any statutory award is in violation of Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and thereupon this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to initiate appropriate land acquisition C/SCA/11006/2022 ORDER DATED:
21/03/2023 proceedings and pass an award under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and thereupon be pleased to direct them to release the appropriate compensation with statutory benefits as early as possible.

1 (B) That this Honourable Court may be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus or a writ in the nature of Mandamus and/or any other appropriate writ or order or direction holding that action of the respondent no.3 is illegal, arbitrary and in violation of article 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and thereupon be pleased to direct the respondent no.3 to award damages or rental compensation with regard to the takingover possession of the respective lands since the year 1993.

(C) That during the pendency and final disposal of the present petition, this hon'ble Court may be pleased to pass an interim order directing the respondent no.2 and 3 to calculate the amount of compensation and thereby direct them to pay advance compensation to the petitioners.

(D) That this Honourable Court be pleased to pass such other further orders as the nature and circumstances of the case may demand."
2
It is the case of the petitioners that the possession of the lands of the petitioners were taken away long back and proceedings under the land acquisition has been initiated.

On 13.03.2023, this Court passed the following order:
"Respondent No. 2 and 3 shall personally remain present on 21.03.2023 at 11:00 am.
with appropriate information which will be recorded in the order.
A copy of the order be supplied to learned AGP Mr.Sahil Trivedi for further action.
Re - list this matter on 21.03.2023.

"
4 Both the officers, namely, Ms.Nidhi Siwach, Special Land Acquisition Officer and Shri D.R.Patel,
Dy. Executive Engineer, Roand & Building Department are present in the Court.

5 Today, when the matter is called out, learned AGP Ms.Shrunjal Shah, states that proceedings have already been initiated and within a period of one week from today, appropriate notification shall be issued.
She further states that the entire procedure of acquisition shall be completed within eight weeks including declaration of award.

6 In view of the above statement, we dispose of this C/SCA/11006/2022 ORDER DATED:
21/03/2023 petition with a direction to the respondent authorities to complete the proceedings within a period of four months, including declaring the award.

The petition is disposed of,
accordingly.
Direct service is permitted.
